verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documentation of user roles or granular view/edit permissions for people working on boards or items. The closest items are adjacent and earn no credit: per-agent board-access scoping from the admin (monday-docs-10/43) and developer API OAuth scopes such as `boards:read` (monday-docs-6). Neither is a role or permission system that lets a product manager control who can view or edit work.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can assign granular permissions and roles to control who can view or edit work
